# Champ visual direction for EN3

The visual reference is the existing Chande project. EN3 supplies the subject, copy, photos, routes, and commercial information.

## Palette
- Paper: #EEEAE2 — contrast detail.
- Black: #101012 — footer, framing, dark panels.
- EN3 red: #BD3122 — navigation and action colour.
- Signal red: #E44332 — high-energy strips, image labels, menu and accents.

## Typography
Phudu Bold and Medium create dense uppercase editorial headings. Geist Mono supports small labels and the India clock. EN3's original Instrument Sans remains the readable body face. The three Chande font files are copied into this project's assets/fonts directory; no runtime dependency on the original project remains.

## Layout and motion
Use square edges, asymmetric photo mosaics, a 50/50 desktop hero, numbered navigation, oversized headlines, and strong colour blocks. Mobile puts the statement before the mosaic, stacks feature panels, and keeps touch targets readable. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Use actual EN3 imagery; avoid unrelated stock photos or Chande attendee images.

## Components
Champ navigation and full-page menu; editorial hero; experience filter; tenant detail pages; journal cards; fee calculator; progressive safari selection; local sign-in demo; searchable resource directory; contact and policy pages.

## Motion
The black and EN3-red palette is the user-approved direction. Motion includes mosaic texture animation, slow photo movement, title and navigation entrances, viewport reveals, hover labels, a scrolling type band, full menu transitions, scroll progress, native page transitions where supported, and an immersive keyboard-accessible gallery. Reduced-motion settings disable these animations.
